sections.heading: C2 — Vehicle emergencies and crash responsibilities
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Vehicle emergencies and crash responsibilities

FACT_ID: sec14-R01 | anchor: A115
Share the winter trip's route, expected departure and arrival and destination lodging; keep a charged phone and emergency contact numbers available. [A115]
Source: [A115 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0115]

FACT_ID: sec14-R02 | anchor: A115
If stranded while heavy snow is falling, remain with the vehicle. [A115]
Source: [A115 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0115]

FACT_ID: sec14-R03 | anchor: A115
For a medical emergency where roads are unplowed, the handbook directs contacting local or state police for a coordinated response. [A115]
Source: [A115 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0115]

FACT_ID: sec14-R04 | anchor: A118
If a side impact is imminent, be ready to steer to regain control afterward. [A118]
Source: [A118 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0118]

FACT_ID: sec14-R05 | anchor: A119
After a crash damages an unattended vehicle or other property, make a reasonable effort to locate its owner. [A119]
Source: [A119 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0119]

FACT_ID: sec14-R06 | anchor: A119
If that owner cannot be found, leave a crash note with the driver's name and telephone number. [A119]
Source: [A119 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0119]

FACT_ID: sec14-R07 | anchor: A119
For the unattended-property crash, the handbook requires police notice if someone was hurt or damage exceeds fifteen hundred dollars. [A119]
Source: [A119 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0119]

FACT_ID: sec14-R08 | anchor: A119
After unsuccessful recovery of damages from an uninsured driver, the handbook describes requesting suspension of that driver's privileges; a court judgment precedes any discretionary department suspension. [A119]
Source: [A119 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0119]

FACT_ID: sec14-R09 | anchor: A120
When police or medical personnel are already helping at a crash, continue as officers direct rather than stopping to watch. [A120]
Source: [A120 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0120]

FACT_ID: sec14-R10 | anchor: A120
If first to arrive at a serious-injury crash, stop, call nine-one-one and assist if able. [A120]
Source: [A120 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0120]

FACT_ID: sec14-R11 | anchor: A121
A driver involved in a crash must stop as near the scene as possible without obstructing traffic, even if not at fault. [A121]
Source: [A121 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0121]

FACT_ID: sec14-R12 | anchor: A121
Before police arrive, a vehicle posing a traffic hazard may be moved. [A121]
Source: [A121 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0121]

FACT_ID: sec14-R13 | anchor: A121
The handbook's Quick Clearance rule requires safely moving a crash vehicle to a shoulder, median or emergency lane on an interstate or major divided highway when the crash causes neither injury nor death. [A121]
Source: [A121 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0121]

FACT_ID: sec14-R14 | anchor: A121
Help an injured person as able, but do not remove the person from a wrecked vehicle without medical training unless immediate danger such as fire requires it. [A121]
Source: [A121 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0121]

FACT_ID: sec14-R15 | anchor: A121
Seek police and medical assistance promptly after the crash. [A121]
Source: [A121 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0121]

FACT_ID: sec14-R16 | anchor: A121
The handbook requires police reporting of a motor-vehicle crash with an injury or property damage greater than fifteen hundred dollars. [A121]
Source: [A121 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0121]

FACT_ID: sec14-R17 | anchor: A121
At the scene, exchange the listed injured-person names, addresses and license numbers, witness names and addresses, and vehicle-owner names, addresses and insurance policy numbers. [A121]
Source: [A121 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0121]

FACT_ID: sec14-R18 | anchor: A121
Supplying false crash-exchange information may be a misdemeanor; an officer present can help drivers exchange details. [A121]
Source: [A121 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0121]

ranked.label: Prepare for stranding and respond at a crash

corpus_stability.reason: Corpus is the frozen July handbook snapshot; future issuer changes require a new source registration, rather than silent updates to this corpus.

verification_debt.claim_text: The headrest-pressure and front-impact face-protection instructions on physical page one hundred eighteen require current vehicle/airbag and clinical review. The arms-and-hands face instruction is withheld; no universal occupant-position prescription is inferred.

Physical pages one hundred nineteen and one hundred twenty-one give a property-damage threshold above fifteen hundred dollars, or injury, for police notification. The source amount and strict inequality are preserved, but present legal currency remains unverified and blocks release of a current-law claim.

Physical page one hundred twenty-one summarizes good-faith civil-liability protection without the complete statute or exceptions. No blanket immunity guarantee is taught; the legal scope requires the reserved review.

Physical page one hundred nineteen links an uninsured driver's possible suspension to payment or up to six years. The relation of those endpoints and current department procedure are not resolved by the paragraph. Do not invent a definite duration or guaranteed collection outcome.
The most-deaths claim for people leaving cars in heavy snow on physical page one hundred fifteen lacks a dated study and is withheld; the conditional stay-with-vehicle instruction is retained.
